seoTitle: How to Make Narrow Margins in Google Docs (2026)
metaDescription: Reduce Google Docs margins to half-inch or custom sizes using Page Setup or the ruler, then save the layout as your default for future documents.
intro: Shrinking your margins is an easy way to fit more text onto a page and reduce wasted white space. This guide covers using the Page Setup dashboard to enter custom margin values, adjusting margins on the fly with the visual ruler, and saving your narrow layout as the default so new documents start with more usable space.

steps.heading: Open Page Setup
steps.body: Go to your document's File menu and launch the Page Setup configuration wizard to review current margin settings.

steps.heading: Choose narrow margin dimensions
steps.body: Switch from standard whole-inch margins to a narrower half-inch setup across top, bottom, left, and right fields.

steps.heading: Enter custom values if needed
steps.body: Overwrite the input fields with precise fractional measurements to isolate an even more specific printable text grid.

steps.heading: Use the ruler for quick adjustments
steps.body: On desktop, drag the visual ruler sliders to nudge individual margins without opening the Page Setup menu each time.

steps.heading: Set narrow margins as your default
steps.body: Check the Set as default option to apply your new margin settings automatically to all future documents.

steps.heading: Check printable boundaries
steps.body: Verify your printer's minimum margin requirements before finalizing, to avoid content getting cut off during physical printing.

faq.question: What is considered a narrow margin in Google Docs?
faq.answer: A half-inch margin on all sides is the traditional narrow margin setting, compared to the standard one-inch default.

faq.question: Can I set different margin sizes for each side of the page?
faq.answer: Yes, the top, bottom, left, and right margin fields in Page Setup can each be set to different custom values independently.

faq.question: Will narrow margins cause my document to be cut off when printed?
faq.answer: Some printers have minimum margin requirements, so it's worth checking your printer's specifications before finalizing extremely narrow settings.

faq.question: How do I make narrow margins apply to every new document I create?
faq.answer: Use the Set as default checkbox in Page Setup after configuring your desired margins so the setting carries over to future files.
